snapshot.title: Build Earth weather engine core (cycle + event API)
snapshot.description: Add a reusable script/component that drives normalized time-of-day, day/night interpolation over 60s, and a plugin-style weather event API for effects.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Engine exposes configurable cycle duration with default 60 seconds
Engine emits/updates normalized day-night factor for visuals
Engine provides modular hooks to add/remove weather events without scene rewrites
